name: New England Avenue
description: A fairground entry route running from Gate 9A toward the Court of Honor Stage and Coliseum.

name: The Front Porch
description: A shaded corner near the Court of Honor Stage with seating.

name: Commonwealth Avenue
description: A main fairground thoroughfare with connections to surrounding side roads.

name: Food Court
description: A dense fairground area with seating and shade.

name: Avenue of States
description: The main road through the back of the fairground, alongside the New England state-house buildings.

name: Craft Common
description: A green space with trees and nearby shops.

name: East Road
description: A connecting road passing the Mallary Complex, Midway, Food Court, and Young Building.

name: West Road
description: A connecting road between the Midway and Coliseum that leads toward The Big E Arena.

name: Springfield Road
description: A fairground road that serves as an entry route from Gate 7.

name: Industrial Avenue
description: A lively avenue between the Better Living Center and the main road.

name: Hampden Avenue
description: An avenue between Gate 1 and the Court of Honor Stage plaza, near shops and animal attractions.

name: Young Building
description: An indoor commercial building, also known as the International Building, with entrances on each side.

name: Better Living Center
description: An indoor building with commercial vendors.

name: State Buildings
description: Replicas of the six New England state houses, each representing its state.
